mapper.select:
select p.proposal_id proposalId,p.record_id recordId,p.proposal_no proposalNo,p.title, p.applicant_user_id applicantUserId,u.nick_name applicantName,d.dept_name deptName, p.planned_start_date plannedStartDate,p.planned_end_date plannedEndDate, p.requested_budget requestedBudget,p.status,p.submitted_at submittedAt,p.update_time updateTime from research_proposal p left join sys_user u on u.user_id=p.applicant_user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=p.applicant_dept_id
and p.applicant_user_id=#{ownerUserId} and p.status=#{status}
and (p.title like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or p.proposal_no like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
order by p.update_time desc,p.proposal_id desc

select p.proposal_id proposalId,p.record_id recordId,p.call_id callId,p.proposal_no proposalNo,p.title, p.applicant_user_id applicantUserId,u.nick_name applicantName,p.applicant_dept_id applicantDeptId, d.dept_name deptName,p.background,p.objectives,p.project_scope projectScope,p.out_of_scope outOfScope, p.research_content researchContent,p.methodology,p.innovation_points innovationPoints, p.success_criteria successCriteria,p.planned_start_date plannedStartDate, p.planned_end_date plannedEndDate,p.requested_budget requestedBudget,p.status,p.version, p.submitted_at submittedAt,p.approved_at approvedAt,p.rejected_at rejectedAt, r.record_no recordNo,r.current_phase currentPhase from research_proposal p join research_record r on r.record_id=p.record_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=p.applicant_user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=p.applicant_dept_id where p.proposal_id=#{proposalId}

select m.member_id memberId,m.user_id userId,u.nick_name userName,m.member_role memberRole, m.responsibility,m.planned_allocation plannedAllocation,m.sort_order sortOrder from research_proposal_member m left join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id where m.proposal_id=#{proposalId} order by m.sort_order,m.member_id
select budget_line_id budgetLineId,category,amount,description,sort_order sortOrder from research_proposal_budget_line where proposal_id=#{proposalId} order by sort_order,budget_line_id

select expected_output_id expectedOutputId,output_type outputType,name,target_quantity targetQuantity, target_description targetDescription from research_expected_output where proposal_id=#{proposalId} order by expected_output_id
select count(*) from research_proposal_member where proposal_id=#{proposalId}
select count(*) from research_proposal_budget_line where proposal_id=#{proposalId}
mapper.update: update research_review set reviewer_user_id=#{reviewerId},decision=#{decision},comment=#{comment}, status='COMPLETED',completed_at=sysdate() where proposal_id=#{proposalId} and status='PENDING' order by review_id desc limit 1
mapper.select: select award_id awardId,record_id recordId,proposal_id proposalId,award_no awardNo, approved_title approvedTitle,approved_start_date approvedStartDate,approved_end_date approvedEndDate, approved_budget approvedBudget,approved_scope approvedScope,approved_objectives approvedObjectives, approved_outputs approvedOutputs,status,issued_at issuedAt from research_award where proposal_id=#{proposalId}
mapper.insert: insert into research_budget_line(budget_id,category,planned_amount,description) select #{budgetId},category,amount,description from research_proposal_budget_line where proposal_id=#{proposalId}
mapper.select:
select p.project_id projectId,p.record_id recordId,p.project_no projectNo,p.project_name projectName, p.pi_user_id piUserId,u.nick_name piName,d.dept_name deptName,p.current_planned_start_date plannedStartDate, p.current_planned_end_date plannedEndDate,p.current_budget currentBudget,p.progress,p.status, p.current_baseline_id currentBaselineId, coalesce((select sum(e.amount) from research_expense e where e.project_id=p.project_id),0) usedBudget, (select count(*) from research_risk r where r.project_id=p.project_id and r.status in ('OPEN','MONITORING') and r.risk_level in ('HIGH','CRITICAL')) highRiskCount, (select count(*) from research_issue i where i.project_id=p.project_id and i.status in ('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS')) openIssueCount from research_project p left join sys_user u on u.user_id=p.pi_user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=p.dept_id
and (p.pi_user_id=#{userId} or exists(select 1 from research_project_member pm where pm.project_id=p.project_id and pm.user_id=#{userId} and pm.status='ACTIVE'))
and p.status=#{status}
and (p.project_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or p.project_no like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
order by p.update_time desc,p.project_id desc

select p.project_id projectId,p.record_id recordId,p.proposal_id proposalId,p.award_id awardId, p.project_no projectNo,p.project_name projectName,p.pi_user_id piUserId,u.nick_name piName,p.dept_id deptId, d.dept_name deptName,p.current_baseline_id currentBaselineId,p.current_planned_start_date plannedStartDate, p.current_planned_end_date plannedEndDate,p.current_budget currentBudget,p.progress,p.status,p.version, p.activated_at activatedAt,p.closed_at closedAt, a.approved_scope approvedScope,a.approved_objectives approvedObjectives,a.approved_outputs approvedOutputs, a.award_no awardNo,a.approved_budget awardBudget, pr.background,pr.methodology,pr.innovation_points innovationPoints,pr.success_criteria successCriteria, coalesce((select sum(e.amount) from research_expense e where e.project_id=p.project_id),0) usedBudget from research_project p join research_award a on a.award_id=p.award_id join research_proposal pr on pr.proposal_id=p.proposal_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=p.pi_user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=p.dept_id where p.project_id=#{projectId}

select m.member_id memberId,m.user_id userId,u.nick_name userName,m.member_role memberRole, m.responsibility,m.allocation_percent allocationPercent,m.join_date joinDate,m.status from research_project_member m left join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id where m.project_id=#{projectId} order by case when m.member_role='PI' then 0 else 1 end,m.member_id

select w.work_item_id workItemId,w.parent_id parentId,w.item_type itemType,w.wbs_code wbsCode,w.title,w.description, w.owner_user_id ownerUserId,u.nick_name ownerName,w.planned_start_date plannedStartDate, w.planned_end_date plannedEndDate,w.actual_start_date actualStartDate,w.actual_end_date actualEndDate, w.weight,w.progress,w.status,w.priority,w.sort_order sortOrder from research_work_item w left join sys_user u on u.user_id=w.owner_user_id where w.project_id=#{projectId} order by w.sort_order,w.work_item_id

select baseline_id baselineId,version_no versionNo,source_type sourceType,source_id sourceId, planned_start_date plannedStartDate,planned_end_date plannedEndDate,approved_budget approvedBudget, effective_at effectiveAt,status from research_baseline where project_id=#{projectId} order by version_no desc

select b.baseline_id baselineId,b.version_no versionNo,b.source_type sourceType,b.source_id sourceId, b.planned_start_date plannedStartDate,b.planned_end_date plannedEndDate,b.approved_budget approvedBudget, b.scope_snapshot scopeSnapshot,b.objective_snapshot objectiveSnapshot,b.output_snapshot outputSnapshot, b.work_plan_snapshot workPlanSnapshot,b.budget_snapshot budgetSnapshot,b.effective_at effectiveAt,b.status from research_baseline b join research_project p on p.current_baseline_id=b.baseline_id where p.project_id=#{projectId}

select r.report_id reportId,r.report_no reportNo,r.report_type reportType,r.period_start periodStart,r.period_end periodEnd, r.overall_progress overallProgress,r.completed_work completedWork,r.key_achievements keyAchievements,r.problems,r.risks, r.next_plan nextPlan,r.support_needed supportNeeded,r.budget_summary budgetSummary,r.status, u.nick_name preparedByName,r.submitted_at submittedAt from research_progress_report r left join sys_user u on u.user_id=r.prepared_by where r.project_id=#{projectId} order by coalesce(r.submitted_at,r.create_time) desc

select r.risk_id riskId,r.risk_no riskNo,r.title,r.description,r.category,r.probability,r.impact,r.score, r.risk_level riskLevel,r.trigger_condition triggerCondition,r.response_strategy responseStrategy, r.owner_user_id ownerUserId,u.nick_name ownerName,r.source,r.rule_code ruleCode,r.status,r.identified_at identifiedAt from research_risk r left join sys_user u on u.user_id=r.owner_user_id where r.project_id=#{projectId} order by field(r.risk_level,'CRITICAL','HIGH','MEDIUM','LOW'),r.risk_id desc

select i.issue_id issueId,i.source_risk_id sourceRiskId,i.issue_no issueNo,i.title,i.description,i.severity, i.owner_user_id ownerUserId,u.nick_name ownerName,i.occurred_at occurredAt,i.due_date dueDate,i.status, i.resolution,i.resolved_at resolvedAt from research_issue i left join sys_user u on u.user_id=i.owner_user_id where i.project_id=#{projectId} order by field(i.severity,'CRITICAL','HIGH','MEDIUM','LOW'),i.issue_id desc

select c.change_id changeId,c.change_no changeNo,c.title,c.reason,c.applicant_user_id applicantUserId, u.nick_name applicantName,c.scope_impact scopeImpact,c.schedule_impact scheduleImpact,c.cost_impact costImpact, c.output_impact outputImpact,c.risk_impact riskImpact,c.status,c.submitted_at submittedAt, c.approved_at approvedAt,c.applied_at appliedAt from research_change_request c left join sys_user u on u.user_id=c.applicant_user_id where c.project_id=#{projectId} order by c.change_id desc

select change_item_id changeItemId,change_type changeType,field_code fieldCode,before_value beforeValue, after_value afterValue,description from research_change_item where change_id=#{changeId} order by change_item_id

select b.budget_id budgetId,b.version_no versionNo,b.total_amount totalAmount,b.status,b.effective_at effectiveAt from research_budget b where b.project_id=#{projectId} and b.status='ACTIVE' order by b.version_no desc limit 1

select l.budget_line_id budgetLineId,l.category,l.planned_amount plannedAmount,l.description, coalesce((select sum(e.amount) from research_expense e where e.budget_line_id=l.budget_line_id),0) usedAmount from research_budget_line l join research_budget b on b.budget_id=l.budget_id where b.project_id=#{projectId} and b.status='ACTIVE' order by l.budget_line_id

select e.expense_id expenseId,e.budget_line_id budgetLineId,l.category,e.expense_no expenseNo, e.expense_date expenseDate,e.amount,e.description,e.reference_no referenceNo from research_expense e left join research_budget_line l on l.budget_line_id=e.budget_line_id where e.project_id=#{projectId} order by e.expense_date desc,e.expense_id desc
select coalesce(sum(amount),0) from research_expense where project_id=#{projectId}

select o.outcome_id outcomeId,o.expected_output_id expectedOutputId,o.outcome_type outcomeType,o.name,o.description, o.status,o.completed_date completedDate,o.external_reference externalReference, eo.name expectedName,eo.target_quantity targetQuantity from research_outcome o left join research_expected_output eo on eo.expected_output_id=o.expected_output_id where o.project_id=#{projectId} order by o.completed_date desc,o.outcome_id desc

select acceptance_id acceptanceId,acceptance_no acceptanceNo,project_summary projectSummary, completion_statement completionStatement,outstanding_items outstandingItems,applicant_user_id applicantUserId, status,submitted_at submittedAt,reviewed_at reviewedAt,review_comment reviewComment from research_acceptance where project_id=#{projectId}

select closeout_id closeoutId,acceptance_id acceptanceId,final_report_complete finalReportComplete, finance_complete financeComplete,outputs_complete outputsComplete,documents_complete documentsComplete, issues_complete issuesComplete,archive_complete archiveComplete,conclusion,status, completed_by completedBy,completed_at completedAt from research_closeout where project_id=#{projectId}

select document_id documentId,record_id recordId,business_type businessType,business_id businessId,category, file_name fileName,storage_provider storageProvider,storage_key storageKey,mime_type mimeType,file_size fileSize, version_no versionNo,status,uploaded_by uploadedBy,uploaded_at uploadedAt from research_document where business_type=#{businessType} and business_id=#{businessId} and status='ACTIVE' order by category,document_id desc

select wa.action_id actionId,wi.workflow_type workflowType,wi.business_type businessType,wi.business_id businessId, wa.step_code stepCode,wa.action,wa.operator_user_id operatorUserId,u.nick_name operatorName,wa.comment,wa.acted_at actedAt from research_workflow_action wa join research_workflow_instance wi on wi.workflow_id=wa.workflow_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=wa.operator_user_id where (wi.business_type='PROJECT' and wi.business_id=#{projectId}) or (wi.business_type='CHANGE_REQUEST' and wi.business_id in (select change_id from research_change_request where project_id=#{projectId})) or (wi.business_type='ACCEPTANCE' and wi.business_id in (select acceptance_id from research_acceptance where project_id=#{projectId})) order by wa.acted_at desc
mapper.update: update research_work_item set status=#{status},progress=#{progress},version=version+1,update_by=#{username}, actual_start_date=if(#{status}='IN_PROGRESS' and actual_start_date is null,curdate(),actual_start_date), actual_end_date=if(#{status}='DONE',curdate(),actual_end_date) where work_item_id=#{workItemId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from research_work_item where project_id=#{projectId}
select count(*) from research_work_item where project_id=#{projectId} and item_type='MILESTONE'
select coalesce(round(sum(progress*coalesce(weight,1))/nullif(sum(coalesce(weight,1)),0)),0) from research_work_item where project_id=#{projectId} and item_type in ('WORK_PACKAGE','TASK','MILESTONE')
mapper.update: update research_baseline set status='SUPERSEDED' where project_id=#{projectId} and status='ACTIVE'
update research_project set current_baseline_id=#{baselineId},status='ACTIVE',activated_at=sysdate(), version=version+1,update_by=#{username} where project_id=#{projectId} and status='PLANNING'
mapper.select: select risk_id riskId,project_id projectId,risk_no riskNo,title,status,risk_level riskLevel from research_risk where risk_id=#{riskId}
select issue_id issueId,project_id projectId,issue_no issueNo,status,severity from research_issue where issue_id=#{issueId}
mapper.update: update research_issue set status='RESOLVED',resolution=#{resolution},resolved_at=sysdate(), version=version+1,update_by=#{username} where issue_id=#{issueId} and status in ('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS')
mapper.select: select change_id changeId,project_id projectId,change_no changeNo,title,reason,applicant_user_id applicantUserId, scope_impact scopeImpact,schedule_impact scheduleImpact,cost_impact costImpact,output_impact outputImpact, risk_impact riskImpact,status,submitted_at submittedAt,approved_at approvedAt,applied_at appliedAt from research_change_request where change_id=#{changeId}
mapper.delete: delete from research_document where business_type=#{businessType} and business_id=#{businessId} and category=#{category}
mapper.update: update research_project set status='CLOSING',closing_at=sysdate(),version=version+1,update_by=#{username} where project_id=#{projectId} and status='ACTIVE'
update research_project set status='CLOSED',closed_at=sysdate(),version=version+1,update_by=#{username} where project_id=#{projectId} and status='CLOSING'
mapper.select: select workflow_id workflowId,workflow_type workflowType,business_type businessType,business_id businessId, status,current_step currentStep,started_by startedBy,started_at startedAt from research_workflow_instance where business_type=#{businessType} and business_id=#{businessId} and status='RUNNING' order by workflow_id desc limit 1

select 'PROPOSAL' businessType,p.proposal_id businessId,p.proposal_no businessNo,p.title, p.status,u.nick_name applicantName,p.submitted_at submittedAt,null projectId from research_proposal p left join sys_user u on u.user_id=p.applicant_user_id where p.status in ('SUBMITTED','UNDER_REVIEW') union all select 'CHANGE_REQUEST',c.change_id,c.change_no,c.title,c.status,u.nick_name,c.submitted_at,c.project_id from research_change_request c left join sys_user u on u.user_id=c.applicant_user_id where c.status in ('SUBMITTED','ASSESSING') union all select 'ACCEPTANCE',a.acceptance_id,a.acceptance_no,p.project_name,a.status,u.nick_name,a.submitted_at,a.project_id from research_acceptance a join research_project p on p.project_id=a.project_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=a.applicant_user_id where a.status in ('SUBMITTED','UNDER_REVIEW') order by submittedAt desc

select r.risk_id riskId,r.project_id projectId,p.project_no projectNo,p.project_name projectName,r.risk_no riskNo, r.title,r.description,r.category,r.probability,r.impact,r.score,r.risk_level riskLevel,r.status,r.source, u.nick_name ownerName,r.identified_at identifiedAt from research_risk r join research_project p on p.project_id=r.project_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=r.owner_user_id where r.status in ('OPEN','MONITORING','OCCURRED')
and (p.pi_user_id=#{userId} or exists(select 1 from research_project_member pm where pm.project_id=p.project_id and pm.user_id=#{userId}))
order by field(r.risk_level,'CRITICAL','HIGH','MEDIUM','LOW'),r.risk_id desc

select (select count(*) from research_proposal p where p.applicant_user_id=#{userId}) proposalCount, (select count(*) from research_proposal p where p.status in ('SUBMITTED','UNDER_REVIEW')) pendingReview, (select count(*) from research_project p where p.pi_user_id=#{userId} or exists(select 1 from research_project_member pm where pm.project_id=p.project_id and pm.user_id=#{userId})) projectCount, (select count(*) from research_project p where p.status='ACTIVE' and (p.pi_user_id=#{userId} or exists(select 1 from research_project_member pm where pm.project_id=p.project_id and pm.user_id=#{userId}))) activeProjects, (select count(*) from research_risk r join research_project p on p.project_id=r.project_id where r.status in ('OPEN','MONITORING') and r.risk_level in ('HIGH','CRITICAL') and (p.pi_user_id=#{userId} or exists(select 1 from research_project_member pm where pm.project_id=p.project_id and pm.user_id=#{userId}))) highRiskCount, (select count(*) from research_issue i join research_project p on p.project_id=i.project_id where i.status in ('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS') and (p.pi_user_id=#{userId} or exists(select 1 from research_project_member pm where pm.project_id=p.project_id and pm.user_id=#{userId}))) openIssueCount

select p.status name,count(*) value from research_project p
and (p.pi_user_id=#{userId} or exists(select 1 from research_project_member pm where pm.project_id=p.project_id and pm.user_id=#{userId}))
group by p.status

select coalesce(sum(p.current_budget),0) totalBudget, coalesce(sum((select sum(e.amount) from research_expense e where e.project_id=p.project_id)),0) usedBudget from research_project p
and (p.pi_user_id=#{userId} or exists(select 1 from research_project_member pm where pm.project_id=p.project_id and pm.user_id=#{userId}))
